LESSON: TEACHINGS ON PRAYER

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: TEACHINGS OF JESUS CHRIST
Topic 4.1: Teachings on Prayer

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Teachings on Prayer
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you apply the teachings of Jesus Christ in your day-to-day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. discuss the importance of having faith when they pray to God
2. demonstrate love by praying for all people
3. apply lessons learnt by praying persistently

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: discuss the importance of having faith when they pray to God

Teach

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “discuss the importance of having faith when they pray to God” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "discuss the importance of having faith when they pray to God" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: demonstrate love by praying for all people

• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “demonstrate love by praying for all people” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: apply lessons learnt by praying persistently

• Listen/read the idea.

• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “apply lessons learnt by praying persistently” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "apply lessons learnt by praying persistently" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: discuss the importance of having faith when they pray to God
• Model 2: demonstrate love by praying for all people
• Model 3: apply lessons learnt by praying persistently

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: discuss the importance of having faith when they pray to God
2. Practise: demonstrate love by praying for all people
3. Practise: apply lessons learnt by praying persistently

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Teachings on Prayer.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you apply the teachings of Jesus Christ in your day-to-day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• discuss the importance of having faith when they pray to God
• demonstrate love by praying for all people
• apply lessons learnt by praying persistently
